title: i swallow this pill to track my body
description: i swallow this pill thermometer to track my body

segments.text: This pill looks normal, but it's not. It's actually a mini computer. It's the size of a vitamin and it measures my temperature from inside my body, taking nearly 3,000 readings every single day. All to answer what happens to my temperature [music] across my menstrual cycle. Most women were never taught that after ovulation for about 2 weeks, your body runs hotter, about half a degree Fahrenheit. Therefore, your temperature is a hormone report. But, nearly 100 years of temperature data [music] is based upon women taking one measurement per morning on their temperature. But, your temperature isn't one number. It

rises and falls 24/7. This pill takes a reading every 30 seconds and [music] sends it to this receiver nearby. Then, it takes about a day to exit my body naturally. Single use, obviously, and then I swallow the next one. This allows us to ask questions like, when does my temperature rise? Is it the day I ovulate or the day after? I'm measuring my temperature six different ways along 1,900 other biomarkers. This is one part of my experiment to make female biology more legible. My first full cycle is being analyzed right now [music] and I'll share what we find soon.
